answer_1.quote: We conduct comprehensive evaluations on various generation tasks. MT-Bench for multi-turn conversation; GSM8K for mathematical reasoning; HumanEval, MBPP and ClassEval for code generation.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs in dialogue and code generation tasks using LLMs.
